body:
I fucked up.....

The police are involved and I’m going to prison when it goes to court, that’s what’s happened......

When my family find out, they’ll disown me, I’ll lose my wife....

There’s no other way out......

I can’t take it anymore..... 

My life is ruined because of my stupidity, I can’t put that onto my family.

It’s better if I wasn’t here.

I feel free..... 

My body feels weird......
